params.caption: 🎮 Final Fantasy 14 opens its longest free login period before Evercold The Road to Evercold has begun: FF14 is running what is described as its "longest" free login campaign ahead of the next expansion, and lapsed players can also pay $10 to skip the Dawntrail story.
